title: Nvidia's role as AI financier faces first big test as neoclouds take market hit
script:
Stocks for Nvidia-backed cloud providers have fallen thirty percent this month.
These niche providers, known as neoclouds, rely on Nvidia hardware to scale their AI operations.
CEO Jensen Huang has used Nvidia to bankroll these firms to secure AI chip demand.
Investors are now questioning if these firms can generate consistent profits from their massive spending.
Public markets are punishing companies that lack clear paths to long-term revenue growth.
This shift marks the first major test for the AI financing model Nvidia pioneered.
